title: Zinc Ore Ultra
description: Sets zinc ore generation to the maximum
body:
# Zinc Ore Ultra

Sets the generation of zinc ore (Create) to the maximum value to work with the ore plus ultra datapack. 

## Requirements

This datapack needs the datapack [Ore Plus Ultra](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ore_plus_ultra) and the mod [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) to work.
